Parsers / CIMB OCTO

CIMB OCTO

Untested — help us with real samples v1 By PayPing Community
Download .json

Parser Rules (4)

cimb.received-title.v1
Priority: 200 Money In
Match Title:
transfer received|money received|funds received|incoming
Extract amount:
-?\s?(?:RM|MYR)\s?-?\s?(?<amount>[\d,]+\.?\d{0,2})
Extract counterparty:
(?:received from|from) (?<counterparty>.+?)(?: on| via| ref|\.|$)
Extract reference:
(?:ref(?:erence)?|transaction)\s?(?:no|number)?:?\s?(?<reference>[A-Z0-9]+)
cimb.received-body.v1
Priority: 190 Money In
Match Body:
received from|credited to your account|transferred to you
Extract amount:
-?\s?(?:RM|MYR)\s?-?\s?(?<amount>[\d,]+\.?\d{0,2})
Extract counterparty:
(?:received from|from) (?<counterparty>.+?)(?: on| via| ref|\.|$)
Extract reference:
(?:ref(?:erence)?|transaction)\s?(?:no|number)?:?\s?(?<reference>[A-Z0-9]+)
cimb.sent-title.v1
Priority: 180 Money Out
Match Title:
transfer successful|payment successful|transaction completed
Extract amount:
-?\s?(?:RM|MYR)\s?-?\s?(?<amount>[\d,]+\.?\d{0,2})
Extract counterparty:
(?:to Acct RM[\d,. ]+ to|(?:transferred|paid) to|to) (?<counterparty>.+?)(?: on\b| ref\b|\.|$)
Extract reference:
(?:ref(?:erence)?|transaction)\s?(?:no|number)?:?\s?(?<reference>[A-Z0-9]+)
cimb.sent-body.v1
Priority: 170 Money Out
Match Body:
transferred to|debited from your account|paid to|duitnow to acct
Extract amount:
-?\s?(?:RM|MYR)\s?-?\s?(?<amount>[\d,]+\.?\d{0,2})
Extract counterparty:
(?:to Acct RM[\d,. ]+ to|(?:transferred|paid) to|to) (?<counterparty>.+?)(?: on\b| ref\b|\.|$)
Extract reference:
(?:ref(?:erence)?|transaction)\s?(?:no|number)?:?\s?(?<reference>[A-Z0-9]+)

How to Import in App

  1. Click Copy JSON above.
  2. Open PayPing Lite on your phone.
  3. Open the Bank Rules tab.
  4. Tap + Add Bank Rule and paste.
